apk.why: Measured on builds 30, 36 and 37: 145.51 MB, identical across builds (size has no run-to-run noise). Installs stream the APK over Wi-Fi to frames with little free storage; growth past these numbers means a new dependency or a second ABI and must be seen in review.

abis.why: Both frames are ARMv7; a second ABI would add about 131 MB

native_bytes.why: 130.7 MB today, 113.3 MB of it GeckoView's libxul.so

gecko_omni_bytes.why: assets/omni.ja is Gecko's own: 13.62 MB today

other_assets_bytes.why: fonts and page bridges, 0.2 MB today; catches a large image, font or bundle

new_entry_bytes.why: any single entry over 1 MB not listed here is a new heavy dependency

device.why: Measured by device/memory_ab.py (60 s windows); see docs/touch-performance-history.md for the runs and the noise floor behind each number.

touch_pss_mb.why: build 41, 5 runs 10/17: median 342, max 362, run-to-run spread 59 MB (Gecko varies with the photo and its caches); max + spread

cpu_percent_main_plus_gpu.why: target, fails today: a still photo with a 1 s fade every ~7 s should cost a few percent; build 41 measures 90-92 (spread 2.3) because Kiosk's per-frame slide timer redraws an unchanged photo (10/13 runtime audit, Critical)

app_frames_per_minute.why: target, fails today: one 1 s fade per slide is about 25 frames x 8.5 slides a minute; build 41 measures 1,325-1,643 (about 22-27 fps) for the same Kiosk timer

touch_pss_mb.why: build 41, 5 runs: median 240, max 256, spread 17 MB, with the Photos page released after 2 minutes away; build 37 held 325

latency.why: Wyatt's targets (10/17). Measured by device/latency_sampler.py: raw on-device captures every ~0.8 s for photos, framestats bracketed by the device clock for taps (times after the tap command returned, so a lower bound by up to ~0.3 s).

photos_picture_after_return_s.why: a picture on screen within 1 s of tapping Photos, warm or after the page was released

photos_picture_after_cold_start_s.why: a picture on screen within 3 s of Touch starting

new_screen_after_tap_ms.why: navigation budget for a menu tap to a native screen

touch_process_kills.why: a kernel kill of any Touch process during the check is a regression (10/14 the foreground app was killed)
